NO uniformity-in-c claim and NO per-c polynomial claim — those are route strengthenings (kept below). Pre-registered falsifier: scaled official-like rows with a super-budget top-band petal family, sustained across scales; below-top behavior is Lemma-13-clean (76-row scan, max exact count 1). | Full-petal extras at cofactor excess d-ell = c are poly(n) uniformly in c (equivalently: the amplification bound closes the Thm 21/B11 escape route). | SURVIVAL +1 (2026-07-07, F4-A1, notes/f4a1_topband_ladder_modal.py): 7-rung prime ladder (109..6421, all gates PASS) — top-band max exact count EXACTLY 5005 = C(15,6) at every rung (slope +0.000; p-independent, purely binomial), below-top <= 1, zero Lemma-13 violations. The floor's n^B claim holds flat; constructive lead: the top-band family is combinatorially parameterized (the demanded paid family is a binomial column — identify and prove it on the route side). | SURVIVAL +2 scoped (2026-07-07, F4-A2): adversarial c-sweep to c=14 — top-band count steps C(15,6) -> C(20,6) = 38760: bounded-degree (6) binomial growth in the excess parameter, absorbed by any c-uniform n^B budget; the paid-family lead sharpens to a 6-dimensional binomial column. Large-p c-sweep completeness and the exact offset formula to F4-A2b. | SURVIVAL +3 -> **HARDENED** (2026-07-07, F4-A2b): the top band has a two-regime structure — at-top realizability SATURATES to the full binomial window p-independently (the paid family, exactly chargeable; the ladder's constant 5005 refined to this semantics), below-top accidents decay with p (4->0, 2->0), Lemma-13 zero violations everywhere. Families: p-ladder / c-growth / kernel-ceiling. | Pro floor-window 4: no kill; budget implication completed and replayed (C(n+6,6) <= n^6 at all four official maximal rows, exponent <= 5.785) — the saturated column provably fits n^6. || SLACK-SCAN ADDENDUM (2026-07-09, floor_budget_slack_scan): NOT BINDING — the saturated degree-6 binomial column sits ~9.5 bits under n^6 at all four official maximal rows (exponents 5.7685..5.7843, exact recompute; banked <= 5.785 confirmed); the excess-c column keeps degree 6. B_max > 6 would be gated by the codegree-conversion emission (imgfib -> list_safe): named open cell, compute only if the route needs it. | WP6 KERNEL-BASIS VERDICT (2026-07-10, notes/kernel_basis/WP6_PETAL_VERDICT.md): REDUCTION-PARTIAL onto K4 (stabilizer-primitive image-fiber bound) — Codex's four E22 packets replayed PROVED (10/10 verifiers; ledger walls + algebraic entry real; staircase column exactly matches the planted lower count, separate charge NECESSARY; ~9.5 bits slack at exponent 5.785) but three named gaps block the amber: G1 layer-map supply for arbitrary U (upstream withholds), G2 support-forcing dichotomy (the central bridge, proved nowhere; F4-A2b empirics are evidence only), G3 pricing multiplicity (WP6 wrote 'referenced node exists nowhere' — CORRECTED 2026-07-10 amber audit Catch A: e22_cross_scale_pricing_multiplicity EXISTS locally since Jul 5 with status PROVED, but rides on the WP6-unreplayed fifth branch, so G3 stays a predicate per the anti-goal). Fifth E22 branch (minimal-scale accounting) NOT imported. || AMBER SURGERY (2026-07-10, petal amber audit, sequel to WP6): CONDITIONAL — machine-verified assembly implication: IF petal_g1_layer_maps AND petal_g2_support_forcing AND petal_g3_pricing_multiplicity AND petal_k4_primitive_bound (G4/G5 + P1/P3 pinned as definitions in conditional.md) THEN at every official row and every U, the top-band full-petal contribution to #ImgFib_U(k+sigma) splits as [primitive: <= n^{b1+b4}, charged to n^B] + [staircase: <= n^{b1+b3} x planted column, charged to imgfib's quotient-profile budget — the charge proved NECESSARY by v13_capf_planted_lower_count, exact column match]. Every non-predicate link PROVED: pma injection + four E22 packets (verifiers replayed exit-0 twice: WP6 and this audit) + exact arithmetic (exponent <= 5.785, slack = log2 6! = 9.4919 bits at n = 2^41..2^44, composition machine-checked; the 9.5 bits IS the binomial denominator, not structural headroom — do not spend it in predicate exponents). ROUTE OF RECORD: G1 -> pma -> [G4 pin] -> cofactor packets -> G2 -> {staircase: tail-coset + 7-lemma composite -> G3 -> quotient budget | primitive: K4} -> floor. RE-SURGERY (demote to TARGET) if: any predicate falsified as stated; the G4 dictionary check fails on a sweep cell; the fifth-branch replay contradicts the declared W semantics; the band pin P1 (floor band M(t-2) vs scan band (t-1)M — Catch B) is resolved to a different constant; or imgfib's quotient clause is re-scoped so the P3 emission no longer lands. SCOPE: top band only — mixed-petal and below-top are separate obligations, untouched. || #171 BELOW-TOP OBLIGATION NOTE (2026-07-13, from the clause-(P) banking): under the floor posing of the G1 band, the wide-minus-floor aperiodic lift mass (~2^59.67 at (128,64), spread over ~C(t,m) charts) belongs to THIS node's below-top obligation; the banked below-top evidence (76-row Lemma-13 scan, per-chart max 1) neither prices nor contradicts it, and no aggregate budget line exists for it yet. Attached to the owed P1 maintainer request (floor vs wide band decision); a P1 floor confirmation makes this the single open below-top quantity. || P1 CONFIRMED -> PROVED (2026-07-13): the maintainer ruled the top-defect band of record is the FLOOR band d >= M(t-2), layout-anchored (#168) — the strongest form the proofs support (dominates the narrower (t-1)M scan reading; wider-than-floor is killed by counting, 2^59.67 > 2^41.92). With the pin fixed, all eleven wired hypotheses are PROVED (G1 clause (P), G2, G3 compiler, K4, census gate, the E22/v13 suppliers) and the conditional packet discharges: full-petal extras are poly(n) uniformly in c on the top band, off-band by top-coefficient forcing. Confirmation text in conditional.md; proof artifact proof.md. STANDING: tripwire (P)-3 + re-surgery criterion 4 (re-resolution of the band constant re-opens); the #171 wide-minus-floor lift mass is this node's below-top ledger line (separate obligation, flagged above).
